title: Micro Wedding Venues: Real Prices by City (2026)
description: Micro and small wedding venue prices in 5 US cities, from $197 to $1,000, each quoted from the venue's own site. Checked Oct 28, 2026.
h1: Micro wedding venues: real prices by city
answer_html: As of Oct 28, 2026, the lowest micro or small wedding venue price we verified is $197 (The Courthouse Wedding Chapel, Houston). By city: Houston from $197, Chicago from $400, New York from $595, Dallas from $250, Los Angeles from $320. Every price comes from the venue's own website.
oneliner: Lowest verified micro wedding venue price $197 (Houston); three cheapest venues in each of five cities.
facts_intro: A chapel for two is marked “couple only”; the answer above is for 10 or more guests. Tap a city for its three cheapest, or open its page for all of them. Each price is read from the venue's own page.

ideas_lead: Whichever city you pick, the rest of the day can cost less too. One real find in each other category, each from its own page and dated.

faq.q: What would be considered a micro wedding?
faq.a: There is no official cutoff, so we use each venue's own words: the guest limits printed next to the prices on our city pages run from 2 to 175 people. Every venue listed prints its price for a small, micro, weekday or elopement booking.

faq.q: What is a normal cost for a wedding venue?
faq.a: The middle printed price across the 44 venues on our city pages that print one flat price is $875; they run from $197 (The Courthouse Wedding Chapel, Houston, couple only) to $8,900 (County Line Event Center, Houston, packages for up to 50 guests), each from the venue's own website on Oct 28, 2026.

Usually not: there is no official cutoff, but the guest limits printed next to the prices on our city pages run from 2 to 175 people, and 34 of the 42 limits are 50 or fewer. A venue that hosts 100 guests prices a different kind of day, so we list one only when it prints a small-group price.

faq.q: What is a realistic budget for a small wedding?
faq.a: For the venue alone, the prices we verified run from $197 to $8,900. The rest depends on you; our city pages add one real find each for the dress, flowers and photos so you can see how the lines add up.

For a small group, yes: 43 of the 44 priced venues on our city pages are $5,000 or less and 23 are under $1,000, before the dress, flowers, photos and food. A 100-guest wedding is a different budget, because these pages price small groups only.

pay_less_heading: How to pay less for a small venue

pay_less.t: Many venues print a lower price for Monday to Thursday. Open your city to see each venue's weekday and weekend price.
A package adds an officiant, photos or decor you may not need, and its price shows it. Ask what the room costs on its own.
A ceremony and a toast fit in an hour or two. Several venues here sell one-hour and two-hour slots.
Fees, deposits, taxes and extra hours can sit on top of the printed price. Ask for the total in writing before you pay a deposit.
